title: Excellent if you like getting the same teas every month
text:
This review has been updated
My only complaint.....the turmeric tea I received (which is my favorite) only made 3 cups of tea. The others I've gotten 4-6 cups out of each. I love love love Vahdam teas and this subscription box. EXCELLENT
UPDATE 06/15/2021
OK, I'm six months into this subscription and I have one major complaint. For a company that has such a large variety of teas and tea blends, why does it seem that I am getting the same teas over and over and over again? Shouldn't be like this. I shouldn't be receiving so many duplicates and triplicates so soon in this subscription. Its rather disappointing.
UPDATE 07/09/2021
While these teas are certainly the freshest teas I've had, I am very tired of getting the same teas month after month after month. It's as if they take whatever is left over every month and sell it as their subscription teas. I started this subscription to get a taste of their large variety. Instead I am left with a bunch of the same friggin tea every month. Complete waste of my money!!! I think it's time to cancel and move on. Simple Loose Leaf Tea is a GREAT alternative. I've been with them as long as I've been with Vadham and every month I get new and exciting tea blends that I am absolutely loving. In fact, last month I started a second subscription with them. It is a much better choice for me. So long Vadham Teas. Nice knowing you.
label: neutral
